_comment: Named incident replays for the demo. Mirrors GET /scenarios; the backend MockDataSource is authoritative (backend/app/data/mock.py build...scenarios). Curated from data/reference/incidents.csv. Times ISO-8601 UTC, bbox [min_lon,min_lat,max_lon,max_lat].

scenarios.name: Eagle S / Estlink 2
scenarios.narrative: Christmas Eve 2024: the tanker EAGLE S slows over Estlink 2, the engine flags it and recommends a SAR pass on the crossing — the cable is cut ~14 minutes later. Held out of training.

scenarios.name: Yi Peng 3 / BCS East-West + C-Lion1
scenarios.narrative: Bulk carrier Yi Peng 3 cuts two cables on consecutive days south of Sweden.

scenarios.name: Newnew Polar Bear / Balticconnector
scenarios.narrative: Container ship drags anchor across the Balticconnector pipeline + telecom cables.
